programme.desc: Jim Bakker — the pioneer of Christian television who built the PTL Network into one of the largest Christian broadcasting networks in the world and has spent more than six decades proclaiming the gospel — sits down with Joe Ardis Horn and the Skywatch TV team for a deeply personal wide-ranging conversation you wont want to miss Joining Jim are his wife Lori Bakker author of More Than I Could Ever Ask and Mondo De La Vega co-host of The Jim Bakker Show and author of My Crazy Life The Moments That Brought a Gangster to Grace Together they reflect on decades of friendship with the late Dr Tom Horn the faithful legacy he left behind and the miraculous ways God has sustained both the Bakker and Horn ministries through seasons of trial and near collapse Jim opens the Word of God and shares an urgent prophetic message from the Book of Revelation — declaring that we are living in the fulfillment of what Scripture foretold From earthquakes to cultural upheaval from the rapture to the perseverance of the saints this is a conversation for the hour we are in If youve ever wondered what it looks like when God refuses to let a ministry die — this is it

programme.title: Robin Bullock Trumps Prophetic Assignment the Courts of Heaven the Book of Job

programme.title: The Mondo Show - I Survived Escaping a Serial Killer
programme.desc: In this powerful episode of The Mondo Show Midsi Sanchez shares her unbelievable story of survival after being kidnapped by a serial killer at just 8 years old Chained abused and alone Midsi didn’t wait for rescue; she escaped on her own defying all odds But her journey didn’t end there Midsi opens up about the healing process and how she found the strength to forgive her captor turning her trauma into a story of resilience and personal growth This conversation is a moving exploration of survival strength and the transformative power of forgiveness
